subject: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@greenfieldhealth.com, support@safehsm.io
Cc: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

Hi team,

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per Greenfield's request, I'm attaching the initial package we discussed with the artifacts you'll need for the attestation packet and the proposed rotation drill. High-level overview of what's included and the ask: 

- byok-attestation-evidence.zip: contains PGP-signed statements, HSM attestation cert chain (SafeHSM), and our audit log extracts (UTC).
- kek-rotation-matrix.xlsx: proposed rotation windows, operator roles, and rollback playbook.
- vpc-egress-acls.txt: minimal egress rules that correspond to the HSM remote management endpoints and telemetry sinks.
- wireguard-topology.png: diagram showing the site-to-site WireGuard tunnels and per-subnet routing for the KMS control plane.

As discussed, the main asks for Greenfield before the audit window are: 
1) Confirmation that the HSM attestation chain meets your verifier (3PA) expectations.
2) Approval of the rotation windows and whether you require a split-witness witness-holder in addition to the operator separation we proposed.
3) Agreement on the egress lockdown — we propose blocking all outbound IPv4 except the three IPs listed in vpc-egress-acls.txt and allowing DNS only to the internal forwarders.

Next steps: if Greenfield can confirm (1) and (3) by EOD Friday (20 Nov), we will schedule the rotation drill for the week of 30 Nov and loop in SafeHSM for remote attestation validation.

Please reply with any immediate blockers.

Thanks,
Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: byok-attestation-evidence.zip (zip), kek-rotation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), vpc-egress-acls.txt (text), wireguard-topology.png (png)

From: SafeHSM Solutions <support@safehsm.io>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

Hi Camila / team,

Thanks for the package — we validated the attestation cert chain from the HSM and confirmed firmware version and PCR measurements match the expected baseline for your module. A couple of notes from our side: 

- The attestation cert chain in the zip is valid but the chain file is missing the timestamp-stamped OCSP response for 2026-10 that 3PA asked for; we can provide an OCSP archive if you want us to append it.
- Remote management endpoints use a management agent on TCP/8443 with mTLS; please ensure the VPC egress ACLs allow our management IPs and the temporary ephemeral port range for the handshake (we document the 8443 requirement in the attached).
- We recommend adding a second management route via your DR site as a fallback for the rotation drill (so the operator cannot be completely cut off during a test).

We can join the rotation drill remotely and produce an attestation timestamp during the run.

Cheers,
Marta Silva
Customer Success Eng.
SafeHSM Solutions
(attachment: safehsm-ocsp-guidance.pdf)

From: Lara Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

Camila — quick followups from the legal/compliance side after scanning the artifacts: 
- The rotation matrix looks good but we need explicit SCAL-offline approvals recorded in the doc for any emergency unscheduled rotation (audit wants a signature trail). I ticked a column for "approval method" with values phone/email/DocuSign.
- Please ensure the byok-attestation-evidence.zip does not contain any customer PII; I saw a note in the audit-extracts.csv that references a ticket number tied to a Greenfield user. Remove or redact before we hand over to 3PA.

I'll hold on issuing the final evidence share until those two items are cleaned up.

Laura
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Greenfield Health SecOps <security@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

Camila/Laura,

Thanks for the artifacts and the clear asks. A few items from Greenfield's side: 
1) OCSP archive: please include SafeHSM's OCSP stamp as requested — our external auditor (3PA) requires it for chain-of-trust verification.
2) Egress lock: we approve the principle of tight egress but need to keep the internal forwarder for DNS plus an outbound telemetry sink to our Splunk ingest (splunk.greenfieldhealth.net) — please add that host to the ACLs.
3) Split-witness: our security policy expects a 2-of-3 witness model for root-of-trust rotation. We'll meet the operator separation you proposed but require that one witness key is held by our security engineering team (we'll provide contact after legal completes the contract amendment).

Assume approval of rotation windows tentatively — final sign-off after OCSP and removal of any PII from evidence. We can have 3PA join the rotation drill remotely.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Director, Security Engineering
Greenfield Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

All — I've redacted the reference to the Greenfield ticket from the audit-extracts.csv and added a short manifest explaining each file in the zip (manifest.txt). I also: 
- Requested OCSP archive from SafeHSM (Marta), flagged as urgent.
- Updated vpc-egress-acls.txt to include splunk.greenfieldhealth.net (explicit FQDN mapping) and the SafeHSM management IPs; added a secondary CIDR route via the DR site for the rotation drill.
- Touched kek-rotation-matrix.xlsx: added a column for "approval_record_id" and an example DocuSign stub id so Laura can verify.

Proposed drill date: Tue 30 Nov 2026, 10:00 PST. If Greenfield confirms the witness-holder assignment and SafeHSM supplies the OCSP archive by EOD 20 Nov we can lock it in.

Action items assigned: 
- SafeHSM: provide OCSP archive and confirm management ports/ephemeral ranges (Marta).
- Greenfield: confirm witness-holder contact and org-level acceptance of the secondary DR route.
- Laura: final compliance blessing once the manifest / DocuSign id present.
- Jonas: run a pre-drill connectivity check with Greenfield and SafeHSM on 29 Nov.

Sooj
Principal Technical Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BYOK attestation checklist and network egress hardening — proof artifacts & rotation drill plan

Quick update from the infra side after a smoke test this morning: 
- WireGuard mesh: DR path works and failover completes within 11s for control-plane heartbeats. Documented in JIRA: INF-3217.
- ACLs: the route for splunk.greenfieldhealth.net resolves and traffic flows to the expected Splunk ingest; I added a comment in vpc-egress-acls.txt about fallback IPs.
- Rotation drill runbook: I added a small section on operator escalation and timed checkpoints (T+0, T+5, T+15). No config changes required to the HSM agent.

If Marta uploads the OCSP archive today we can produce the final evidence package by EOD and send to 3PA for pre-review. Assuming that goes well, we confirm drill 30 Nov at 10:00 PST.

Jonas
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
